title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-20 01:14:50 最新章节：第2522章 不限次数
slug: 给你玉女心经没让你用双修证道
content_zh:
“卧槽，这特么好像是穿越了？！”黄夜懵逼地看着头顶的房梁。
红彤彤的房梁告诉他在一座古建筑里面。
这是什么鬼地方，这个床明显是古代的床。
床好大，此刻自己正平躺在大床上。
脑海中猛的灌入一些信息，这个步骤对，穿越者都会接收原主信息。
看着里面的信息，黄夜差点没哭出来，我特么穿的是无字天书么！
原主竟然是个傻子，记录的信息很少，只有名字跟他一样，还有个“少爷”的称呼。
剩下就是混沌一片，偶尔会蹦出一个前不着村后不着店的单词。
唯一能确定的是自己确实穿越了。
老天，你这是玩我么，穿越到一个傻子身上，让我来受虐的？
“系统！系统！”黄夜心中默念。
空荡荡的声音在脑海里回荡，什么都没有！
太特么残忍了，一点机会也不给么？！
“吱扭！”一声，房门打开的声音传入耳中，黄夜下意识闭上眼睛。
咦！不对，我的眼睛明明闭上了，怎么还能看见人？
一道娇俏的少女身影出现在屋中，少女回手掩上房门，蹑手蹑脚向床榻走来。
少女身着一袭鹅黄色纱衣，俏丽的容颜略显狰狞。
卧槽，她手里拿的是什么，黄夜懵了。
少女正握着一把铮明瓦亮的匕首，在床前停了一会儿，颤巍巍举起匕首。
比量一下方位，“唰！”的一下，匕首带着一道寒光冲黄夜下面扎下。

从看到少女手里拿着匕首，黄夜的后背冷汗直冒，想坐起来，却发现身体绵软无力。
看到匕首落下，用尽吃奶力气侧了一下身体。
“噗！”的一声，匕首扎进棉被，黄夜堪堪躲过这一击。
少女一怔，怎么回事儿，他怎么能动了，明明给他吃了十香软筋散。
难道是药量不够？不行，要尽快出手。
擦擦头上的汗水，再次举起匕首。
“唰！”的一下，还是老地方。
黄夜再次吃了一回奶，躲过断根一击。
少女愣愣地看着黄夜，这傻子的运气太好了，竟然连续躲过两次。
第三次举起匕首，突然从外面传来一道声音，“晴儿，你怎么没在少爷房里暖床！”
“吴伯，我和月儿服侍完少爷用膳，肚子不舒服，去了几次茅厕。”
“我怕影响少爷睡觉，等好点就过去。”
“赶紧进去，别让少爷凉着了！”
“是！”
黄衫少女听到外面的对话，赶紧把匕首塞到床下，迅速宽衣解带。
content_en:
"Damn it, it looks like you've traveled through time?!" Huang Ye looked at the beams above his head in confusion.
The red beams told him that he was inside an ancient building.
What the hell is this place? This bed is obviously an ancient bed.
The bed is so big, and now I am lying flat on the big bed.
Some information is poured into the mind. If this step is correct, the traveler will receive the information from the original owner.
Looking at the information inside, Huang Ye almost cried. What the hell am I wearing?
The original owner turned out to be a fool. There was very little information recorded, only the name was the same as him, and he was called "Young Master".
What's left is chaos, with the occasional word popping up that makes no sense.
The only thing that was certain was that he had indeed traveled through time.
God, are you kidding me? Time travel to a fool and ask me to be tortured?
"System! System!" Huang Ye thought silently in his heart.
Empty sounds echoed in my mind, nothing!
How cruel, not even giving him a chance? !
"Squeak!" The sound of the door opening reached his ears, and Huang Ye closed his eyes subconsciously.
Hey! No, my eyes are obviously closed, how can I still see people?
A pretty girl's figure appeared in the room. The girl closed the door and tiptoed towards the bed.
The girl is wearing a goose-yellow gauze dress, and her pretty face is slightly ferocious.
Damn it, what was she holding in her hand? Huang Ye was confused.
The girl was holding a bright dagger. She paused for a while in front of the bed and raised the dagger tremblingly.
After comparing the position, "Whoosh!", the dagger plunged under Huang Ye with a ray of cold light.
From the moment he saw the dagger in the girl's hand, Huang Ye broke into cold sweat on his back. He wanted to sit up, but found that his body was weak.
Seeing the dagger falling, he turned his body sideways with all his strength.
With a sound of "Poof!", the dagger pierced the quilt, and Huang Ye barely dodged the blow.
The girl was startled, what was going on? How could he move? She had obviously given him Shixiang Ruanjin Powder.
Is it because the dose of medicine is not enough? No, we have to take action as soon as possible.
Wiping the sweat from his head, he raised the dagger again.
"Shua!", it's still the same place.
Huang Ye drank milk again and avoided the root-cutting blow.
The girl stared blankly at Huang Ye. This fool was so lucky that he managed to escape twice in a row.
The third time he raised the dagger, a voice suddenly came from outside, "Qing'er, why didn't you warm the bed in the young master's room!"
"Uncle Wu, after Yue'er and I served the young master for dinner, our stomachs felt uncomfortable and we went to the toilet several times."
"I'm afraid it will affect the young master's sleep, so I'll go there when he feels better."
"Hurry in, don't let the young master catch a cold!"
"Yes!"
The girl in yellow shirt heard the conversation outside, quickly stuffed the dagger under the bed, and quickly took off her clothes.
